result.note: Tests the India–Sweden Strategic Partnership of May 2026: venue, action plan scope and the trade target.

questions.prompt: Consider the following statements about the India–Sweden Strategic Partnership announced in May 2026:
items: Bilateral ties were elevated to a Strategic Partnership during the Indian Prime Minister's visit to Gothenburg.
It comes with a joint action plan for 2026–2030 covering areas including critical minerals and defence.
The two sides set a target of doubling bilateral trade and investment within ten years.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explain: Statement 3 is wrong because the target is to double bilateral trade and investment within five years, not ten. The two sides also endorsed a joint AI corridor called SITAC, and Sweden awarded Modi the Royal Order of the Polar Star.
questions.source: The two sides endorsed a joint AI corridor (SITAC) and set a target of doubling bilateral trade and investment within five years.
